nativeDiagram.renderer: React Flow from the existing workspace dependencies
nativeDiagram.input: Validated OpenUI nodes and labeled links
nativeDiagram.interaction: Zoom, pan, fit and text equivalent

resourceIdentity: Static official domain mapping and local Simple Icons artwork. Unknown evidence domains use a neutral icon.

native: Validation of a complete streaming prefix
integratedWithExisting: Xroga transport, workspace, persistence, citations and owner-scoped sharing

excluded.AgentInterface and headless adapters: Xroga already owns the conversation and streaming transport.
excluded.Gateway, Autofix and observability: The authorized provider and ledger stay in Xroga. Avoid duplicate model calls and telemetry.
excluded.External Query, Mutation and tool calls: Model presentation cannot grant execution authority.
excluded.Email, Vue, Svelte and Angular renderers: This Workspace runs React and does not render UI through email.

native: Layout, typography, list, badge and cards
Deterministic arithmetic, formatting and data functions in nativeFunctions

excluded.MapView, MapMarker and street routing: Upstream MapLibre design loads tiles and optional routing. No approved staging tile or route provider.
excluded.Image and media: The upstream catalog permits URL loading. Only Xroga-owned verified artifact surfaces have access checks; a native media resolver still needs review.
excluded.HtmlView: No arbitrary HTML or execution in the answer.
excluded.Chess and coach skill registries: They depend on separate, domain-specific state and are outside the shared response contract.
excluded.Random, Now, Today, Shuffle and Pick: Saved snapshots should reproduce their inputs. No live clock or randomness in this registry.
excluded.Pivot, Bucket, Histogram and allocation: Current staged tests cover bounded row operations. Output expansion and corner-case domains require their own limits.
excluded.Other list, date, formatting and color f: See intelligentUiFunctionAudit for each pinned upstream export and the corresponding reason or verified registry binding.

native: Draft / Apply / Cancel presentation interaction adapted from the interruption examples
integratedWithExisting: Workspace activity, approvals and task status remain owned by Xroga. No model-authored UI may approve a real operation.

excluded.CopilotRuntime, useCoAgent and AG-UI tra: A second model loop and state stream would compete with Xroga's authority and ledger.
excluded.Remote actions, useInterrupt and approva: The existing canonical Xroga approvals remain authoritative.
excluded.Remaining A2UI standard surfaces: Each standard component has its own disposition in copilotKitStandard.
